prerequisites: Competencies from the Bachelor's degree program.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can methodically structure and process a task from professional practice within a limited timeframe.
Students can quickly familiarize themselves with a new practical professional task at a scientific level and independently deepen their knowledge in a specific area.
Students can place scientific information and practical professional concepts in the technical context and critically reflect on them.

Students apply standard and advanced procedures and methods learned in their studies to process, structuredly present, and evaluate information and data. With the information gained, they contribute to results-oriented solutions for practical professional problems.
Students can apply methods and procedures learned in their studies to systematically process and solve selected problems of professional practice.
Students can give formal and informal presentations on the topic processed, discuss their results in the work team, and contribute to solving tasks.

Students can adequately assess their individual qualification profile regarding competencies relevant to study success. They recognize the influence of their professional activity and reflect on their personal responsibility.

syllabus_topics: Application of scientific findings and methods to the specific problem
Participation in a project of the project week

assessment_methods.method: Presentation (as part of project week participation)

assessment_rules: The written project report is graded for the Applied Scientific Project. Participation in the project week with a presentation is an ungraded examination performance. The written project report should be 20-40 pages long, and the presentation approximately 10 minutes.
